summary: A fleet's device template is rolled out to all members (e.g. an OS image) and may contain Go-template placeholders referencing device metadata such as {{ .metadata.labels.key }} or {{ .metadata.name }}; only simple text and actions are allowed, no conditionals or loops.
questions: What is a fleet device template?
Can device templates use per-device placeholders?
Are conditionals supported in fleet template placeholders?
